goal: Make txt2audio a first-class LLM agent tool with schema-bound outputs, stable errors, observable long-running execution, artifact metadata, and an MCP-ready contract.

tracks.title: Publish schemas for public JSON outputs
acceptance: Tests load every schema and check required fields.

tracks.title: Use stable machine-readable error envelopes
acceptance: JSON errors include schema_version, status, error_code, error, message, retryable, and details.
Existing consumers that read error still work.
Human mode still prints a concise error line.

tracks.title: Return artifact metadata instead of path-only outputs
acceptance: Run result and chapter manifest include artifact objects with path, format, bytes, chapter_index, clip_index, and role.
Legacy generated_outputs remains available for one transition period.
Agents do not need to scan output directories after a successful run.

tracks.title: Add machine-readable progress events for long runs
acceptance: Final --json stdout remains a single JSON object.
Events include run_started, chapter_started, artifact_created, warning, error, and run_completed.

tracks.title: Expose txt2audio through MCP tools
acceptance: MCP tools reuse the same input and output schemas.
Read-only planning and validation tools are separate from side-effectful conversion.
Tool annotations document read-only, destructive, idempotent, and open-world behavior.

completed_this_pass: Added docs/agent-first-class-plan.md with the first-class agent roadmap.
Added schemas for error, run result, plan result, path validation result, and chapter manifest JSON outputs.
Added schema_version to run, plan, validation, manifest, and error outputs.
Expanded JSON errors with error_code, retryable, and details while preserving the legacy error field.
Added agent contract tests for schema presence and stable error envelopes.
Updated README agent integration docs to point at schemas/ and show schema_version.
Added artifact object schemas shared by run results and chapter manifests.
Added artifact metadata objects to run results and chapter manifests while keeping generated_outputs as a compatibility path list.
Added tests for artifact metadata construction and manifest preservation.
next_actions: Design --events-jsonl PATH|- for long-running progress events.
Add event schemas for run_started, chapter_started, artifact_created, error, and run_completed.
Keep final --json stdout as a single JSON object while routing events to JSON Lines.
